Quick Setup Guide
Try Accuphy Sonar — Before You Buy
Your first step into live sonar starts here.
Step 1: Open the Accuphy Sonar app.
Step 2: Go to Settings.
Step 3: Turn on Simulator Mode.
Step 4: Select a view and start scanning.
Download iOS App
Download Android App
